{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=17|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***More than 150 [[Palestinians]] have been killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] strikes in the last 24 hours. [https://apnews.com/article/mideast-wars-israel-gaza-hamas-hostages-05-17-2025-baec52efaea911bf56f8ec25758b7011 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strikes-kill-least-58-palestinians-overnight-2025-05-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Afghan conflict]]
**Thirteen [[Taliban]] fighters are killed and four others are injured in a bombing at a military base in [[Darah District]], [[Panjshir Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. The [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan]] claims responsibility. [https://www.afintl.com/en/202505179565 (Afghanistan International)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A bus evacuating [[civilian]]s is attacked by a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone]] near [[Bilopillia]], [[Sumy Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing nine people and injuring five others. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/05/17/7512650/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**[[2025 Palm Springs fertility clinic bombing]]
***One person is killed, four others are injured, and significant damage is reported in a [[car bombing]] at a [[fertility clinic]] near the [[Desert Regional Medical Center]] in [[Palm Springs, California|Palm Springs]], [[California]], [[United States]]. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] confirms the explosion was an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://www.desertsun.com/story/news/local/2025/05/17/american-reproductive-centers-hit-by-explosion-in-palm-springs/83700589007/ (''The Desert Sun'')] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/05/car-explosion-near-desert-regional-hospital-in-palm-springs-california/ (BNO News)]
*[[Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute]]
**The chief of the [[Guyana Defence Force]], Omar Khan, says that military reinforcement have been sent to the [[Cuyuní River]] area after [[Venezuela]]n civilians shot at [[Guyana|Guyanese soldiers]] on Thursday, as tensions between both nations increase over a referendum by Venezuela on the [[Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute|Essequibo]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2025/05/17/guyana-refuerza-vigilancia-militar-en-su-frontera-con-venezuela-tras-ataque-a-soldados/™ (Infobae)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]], [[Syrian civil war]]
**Three [[Islamic State]] gunmen are killed and four others are arrested in [[Aleppo]] during a [[military operation]] by the [[Syrian Armed Forces|armed forces]]. Weapons, explosives and uniforms with official insignia are seized. A security forces member is also killed in the confrontation. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/17/at-least-three-killed-as-syrian-forces-raid-isil-hideouts-in-aleppo (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Eura mid-air collision]]
**Five people, including [[Estonia]]n businessmen [[Oleg Sõnajalg]] and [[Priit Jaagant]], are killed when two [[Robinson R44]] civilian helicopters en route to Piikajärvi Airfield [[Mid-air collision|collide mid-air]] and crash into the ground in a forested area near [[Eura]], [[Satakunta]], Finland. [https://news.err.ee/1609697247/no-survivors-in-finland-crash-of-two-helicopters-that-took-off-from-tallinn (Eesti Rahvusringhääling)]
*[[Cuauhtémoc Brooklyn Bridge collision|''Cuauhtémoc'' Brooklyn Bridge collision]]
**Two crew members are killed and twenty-five others are injured, including two critically, when [[Mexican Navy]] training ship {{Ship|ARM|Cuauhtémoc}} with a crew of 277 people on a festive visit collides with the [[Brooklyn Bridge]] in [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. A search and rescue operation is currently underway. The bridge suffered no damage, and has since reopened. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/new-york-city/mexican-navy-ship-hits-brooklyn-bridge-cuauhtemoc-investigation-underway/6268975/ (WNBC-TV)] [https://nypost.com/2025/05/17/us-news/ship-carrying-200-people-hits-the-brooklyn-bridge-as-search-and-rescue-operation-underway/ (''The New York Post'')]
*[[Tornado outbreak sequence of May 15–16, 2025]]
**The death toll from severe weather yesterday, including likely tornadoes, in [[St. Louis, Missouri|St. Louis]], [[Missouri]], and [[Somerset, Kentucky|Somerset]], [[Kentucky]], United States, rises to 31. More severe weather is expected today near the [[Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex]] in [[Texas]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/05/17/nx-s1-5402053/tornadoes-kentucky-missouri-deaths (NPR)] [https://apnews.com/article/tornado-weather-thunderstorms-great-lakes-22395202a65b0c37cc06c541ea772172 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda relations]]
**Hundreds of [[Rwandans|Rwandan]] refugees from the 1994 [[Rwandan genocide|genocide]] return to [[Rwanda]] under the auspices of a [[United Nations]] program. The refugees, mostly [[Hutu people|Hutu]] civilians, were residing in the eastern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-rwanda-hutu-refugees-repatriated-un-4ab95e916b1adf601e17d5ea8e235d5a (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]], [[Blasphemy law in Iran]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Iran]] overturns a 5-year prison sentence imposed by a [[Tehran]] court against singer [[Amir Tataloo]] and confirms his [[death sentence]] for [[Islam and blasphemy|blasphemy]]. Tataloo had been extradited from [[Turkey]] in 2023. [https://newscentral.africa/iran-upholds-death-sentence-for-pop-star-tataloo-on-blasphemy-charges/ (News Central Africa)] [https://iranwire.com/en/society/141154-iranian-rapper-tataloos-death-sentence-overturned/ (IranWire)]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**Three people are killed and another person is critically injured in a [[mass shooting]] outside of a [[nightclub]] in [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], United States. No arrests have been made. [https://komonews.com/news/local/woman-2-men-shot-to-death-outside-seattle-nightclub-mass-shooting-casualty-event-handgun-killing-gun-violence-investigation-police-community-danger-club-bar (KOMO-TV)]
*Eight people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by unidentified gunmen inside a [[tavern]] in [[Umlazi]], [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]]. A manhunt for the suspects has been launched. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/south-africa-bar-mass-shooting-8-dead/?ftag=CNM-00-10aab7e&linkId=821723755 (CBS News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Philippine general election]]
**The twelve winning candidates of the [[2025 Philippine Senate election|Senate election]] held on May 12 are officially proclaimed as [[Senate of the Philippines|senators]][[-elect]]. The [[Alyansa para sa Bagong Pilipinas]] coalition of [[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] wins the most seats with six. However, one of its members, Senator-elect [[Camille Villar]], is also a candidate of the opposition coalition [[DuterTen]], supported by [[Vice President of the Philippines|Vice President]] [[Sara Duterte]], which won a total of five seats. [https://www.inquirer.net/444254/comelec-sets-record-with-early-senate-magic-12-proclamation/ (Inquirer.net)] [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/nation/2025/5/13/alyansa-claims-victory-in-halalan-2025-1829 (ABS-CBN News)]
*Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] leaves the [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]] a month after the [[Constitutional Court of Korea]] [[Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|removed him from office]] due to [[2024 South Korean martial law crisis|his short-lived declaration of martial law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-ex-president-yoon-says-he-is-leaving-conservative-party-2025-05-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024–25 Bundesliga]]
**In [[association football]], [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] are the defending champions of the [[Bundesliga]] after defeating [[TSG 1899 Hoffenheim|TSG Hoffenheim]] 4–0 on the final matchday. [https://www.nbcsports.com/soccer/news/bundesliga-table-standings-leading-scorers-from-2024-25-season (NBC Sports)]
*[[2024–25 FA Cup]]
**In [[English football]], [[Crystal Palace F.C.|Crystal Palace]] wins the [[FA Cup]] after defeating [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] 1–0 in [[2025 FA Cup final|the final]] played at [[Wembley Stadium]] in [[London]]. It is Crystal Palace's first major trophy in the club's 119-year history. [https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/crystal-palace-fa-cup-manchester-city-usmnt-richards-turner (Fox Sports)]
*[[2024–25 Ligue 1]]
**In association football, [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] defeat [[AJ Auxerre]] 3–1 to become [[Ligue 1]] champions. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c39xnm3kdvkt (BBC Sport)]
*[[2025 Preakness Stakes]]
**At the [[Pimlico Race Course]], the horse [[Journalism (horse)|Journalism]], jockeyed by [[Umberto Rispoli]], wins the [[Preakness Stakes]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/sports/horse-racing/journalism-preakness-stakes-win-result-rcna207497 (NBC News)]
